meaning: PASS means the diagnostic ran successfully. Finite checks are not formal proofs. Original verdicts refer to the uploaded draft, not the corrected statements.

results.title: Supporting result 1 E8 algebraic data and reducibility
results.source_paragraphs: 54–56; references to original Theorem 1 and Lemma 2
results.scope: Complete reducibility is an invoked general theorem, not a conclusion of a finite Python test. No universal exponential classical lower bound is established.

evidence.general_proof_scope: Weyl complete reducibility is invoked, not proved by this enumeration.

results.title: Supporting result 2 Encoding and excitation sectors
results.scope: The 248-dimensional representation is adjoint. It is not the dimension of every fundamental E8 representation. A physical-subspace invariant ansatz must be independently established.

evidence.basis_encoding_isometry: Any selected distinct computational basis columns are orthonormal.

results.title: Supporting result 3 Casimir normalization and multiplicities
results.source_paragraphs: 55–57; references to Theorem 4 and Definitions 4 and 5
results.scope: The single-adjoint Casimir is scalar and has no nontrivial irrep decomposition to discover. Full decomposition requires more information than one Casimir spectrum; no polynomial-time VQE guarantee follows.

results.title: Supporting result 4 Deflation and padding hypotheses
results.scope: These are global spectral statements, not VQE convergence guarantees. One vector does not exhaust a degenerate eigenspace. Approximate eigenvectors and restricted ansatz spaces need separate bounds.

evidence.deflation: Another vector in same degenerate eigenspace remains available.

results.title: Supporting result 5 Correct Givens gates and smoothness
results.scope: The original two-CNOT synthesis is not used. The smoothness bound requires the specified parameterization, and does not prove global or exponential optimization convergence.

results.title: Supporting result 6 Surface code checks and resource assumptions
results.scope: The budget does not establish routing, gate synthesis, distillation or circuit-level fault tolerance. Spatial separation, code distance and decoding-window length are distinct variables. A physical-qubit count alone supplies no noise threshold.

results.title: Supporting result 7 Exact ideal distillation model
results.scope: Perfect Clifford operations, independent twirled phase errors and postselection are assumptions. This model does not certify a physical distillation factory or arbitrary input noise.

results.title: Supporting result 8 Cartan normalization and diagonal coordinates
results.scope: A Cartan subalgebra is maximal toral within the Lie algebra, not the center of all represented matrices. The Lie-algebra center of simple E8 is zero.

results.title: Theorem 13 Separate level matching and WZW central charge
results.scope: The Sugawara/current-algebra construction is an invoked framework, not a derivation of a physical E8 interface from root coordinates or qubits. An interface spectrum, boundary conditions, invariant form and orientation must be supplied; root-space intersections alone do not define a level jump.

evidence.not_computed: No field theory or physical boundary is simulated.

results.title: Lemma 6 Decoder graph size and conditional complexity
results.scope: A finite graph size does not certify latency below a coherence time. Weight bit lengths, precision, graph construction, implementation and processor measurements are needed. A decoding window may contain many rounds.

evidence.optional_solver: NOT_RUN: NetworkX not installed; exhaustive oracle completed.
evidence.limitation: Neither the exhaustive oracle nor timings prove O(V^3) or latency.

results.title: Theorem 10 Flat holonomy need not be scalar
results.scope: No connection or adiabatic Hamiltonian is supplied for the hardware. Neither a scalar phase nor absolute immunity to control noise is established.

evidence.curvature: d(dphi)=0 and dphi wedge dphi=0 on annulus

results.title: Theorem 14 Conditional gradient concentration without convergence
results.scope: Concentration does not imply exponential descent or a global minimum. For E(θ)=cos θ, initialization at θ=0 has zero gradient at a maximum. The cited barren-plateau work concerns small gradients under specific randomness assumptions and is not a convergence guarantee.

evidence.not_proved: Continuum concentration is justified in the written martingale argument; examples are not its proof.

results.title: Proposition 15 Conditional thermal response and distinct anomalies
results.scope: This is conditional edge physics. No E8 edge, electromagnetic coupling, thermal equilibration or Hall experiment has been constructed on the proposed register. Orientation reverses the sign of c_minus.

evidence.charge_current: No electromagnetic coupling is specified; electrical Hall conductivity is not computed.

results.title: Theorem 16 Certified cubic distillation bound and resource growth
results.scope: The coefficient 35 is only leading order and cannot replace A in a rigorous upper bound. Parallel depth may scale with levels only under explicit factory, scheduling and code-distance assumptions. Noise in Clifford operations can create a nonzero error floor.

results.title: Theorem 17 Complete diagonal Pauli basis
results.scope: The Lie-algebra center of E8 is zero. Maximal toral inside E8 does not mean maximal diagonal inside End(C^248). Diagonal Pauli completeness does not solve tensor-product multiplicities.

results.title: Theorem 18 Exponential path bound under explicit noise assumptions
results.scope: The conditional path event need not equal all logical faults. Code distance three is not a declaration of separation three, a noise correlation length, or zero correlated logical error. Gap size alone does not specify a hardware cross-talk channel.

evidence.counterexample: A shared logical flip with probability q independent of separation violates a universal decaying envelope.

results.title: Theorem 19 Scalar phases and level one integrability
results.scope: The level-one bulk has no nontrivial anyon sector in this standard theory. Ordinary surface-code e and m excitations are Abelian; engineered defects would require a separately specified model. No mapping from an E8 weight basis to anyonic fusion spaces is provided.

results.title: Theorem 20 Conditional simulation and sampling costs
results.scope: The first-248 encoding is not a Hamming sector. Arbitrary non-Clifford noisy physical-state simulation is not covered by a logical-register cost estimate or stabilizer tracking alone. Hamiltonian construction, optimization iterations, finite precision, output enumeration and measurement decomposition add costs. No efficient full tensor decomposition or 144-qubit simulation is proved.
